name: The deployer
owner: the deployer, in their own words, and the named person who will correct the draft
smallest: one sentence somebody said about one capability on one date
status_note: Eight starting mandates exist, each a want list, a refuse list and an unstated list over the 23 primitives, with a description and per capability notes in prose. The person, the job, the purpose and whose material are not nodes. This is the universe where customisation and consolidation are one mechanism: a customer's mandate is written in their vocabulary and attaches to the grammar by authorises and withholds and to nothing else.

node_types.name: Mandate
node_types.formula: [Mandate] := a node that -authorises-> at least one [Capability]

node_types.name: Deployer
node_types.formula: an [Organisation] or [Person] that -issued-> at least one [Mandate]

node_types.name: Owner
node_types.formula: a [Person] that -corrected-> or -signed-> a [Mandate]; never a team and never a function

node_types.name: Job
node_types.formula: a node a [Mandate] -is_for->, in the deployer's words: draft the reply, fix the build

node_types.name: Expectation
node_types.formula: one row of a [Mandate]: a [Capability] with a stance of wanted, refused or unstated, -said_by-> a [Person] on a date

node_types.name: MaterialOverride
node_types.formula: a node on a [Mandate] that -overrides-> the material value of one [Capability] from U1, with its authority recorded and the default kept visible

node_types.name: Correction
node_types.formula: a [Mandate] that -supersedes-> an earlier one; the sale, on riskmandate.ai's own account

verbs.inverse_reads_as: this capability is authorised by this mandate
this capability is withheld by this mandate

verbs.reads_as: this mandate falls short of this capability it asked for
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this capability is unmet by this deployment shape

verbs.reads_as: this mandate is for this job
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this job is served by these mandates
this mandate was issued by this deployer

verbs.reads_as: this expectation was said by this person on this date

verbs.inverse_reads_as: this mandate was corrected by this person

verbs.reads_as: this mandate overrides whose material this capability reaches
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this capability's material is overridden by this mandate
that claim is superseded by this one

adds: The interchange form lives here and nowhere else. The W3C rights expression vocabulary, with permission, prohibition and duty, constraints, a conflict strategy in which prohibitions win, and inheritance, is a projection of U5 and U6 written out in U7, and it is never claimed to enforce anything, because enforcement is U4. An ODRL Policy is a scoped term in this universe's lexicon; the instrument with bands, a ceiling and a premium on the licence to operate demonstration is a scoped term in U8's; the behaviour policy is the root.

provenance.note: The universe is authored in admin/build/universes.py; the matched counts and the live junctions are computed from the graph on every build.
